coach_labels: The back foot isn't elevated, causing insufficient hip rotation. Your arms are too stiff, and your body isn't relaxed, which prevents proper shoulder movement for exchanging punches. Your stance has a center of gravity that's too high, and your strike point is too low.
Use only your arm's strength, and your arm and upper body are too stiff while your hips do not rotate. Also, your legs are not bending into a semi-squat position.
